title: Shared commercial masters
decision: Sales consumes governed customer/product references and snapshots document-critical values; it does not create divergent master truth.
rationale: Required for enterprise-grade commercial integrity, module isolation and auditable recovery.
alternatives_considered: Duplicated Sales-only masters

title: Deterministic commercial math
decision: Pricing, discounts, tax and margin are deterministic decimal calculations with explainable traces; AI has no authority over these values.
rationale: Required for enterprise-grade commercial integrity, module isolation and auditable recovery.
alternatives_considered: LLM-generated or browser-only totals

title: Versioned documents
decision: Sent/accepted quotations and confirmed/amended orders retain immutable version snapshots and history.
rationale: Required for enterprise-grade commercial integrity, module isolation and auditable recovery.
alternatives_considered: Mutable in-place commercial history

title: Stock ownership
decision: Stock owns availability, reservation and warehouse execution; Sales owns customer commitment and consumes public Stock contracts.
rationale: Required for enterprise-grade commercial integrity, module isolation and auditable recovery.
alternatives_considered: Direct Sales writes to Stock private tables

title: Accounting ownership
decision: Sales issues idempotent financial requests while Accounting owns posted invoices, AR, payments and legal corrections.
rationale: Required for enterprise-grade commercial integrity, module isolation and auditable recovery.
alternatives_considered: Sales posting directly to ledger tables

title: AI boundary
decision: Sales AI may summarize, draft and recommend from authorized evidence; critical state and commercial/financial truth use normal domain commands and approvals.
rationale: Required for enterprise-grade commercial integrity, module isolation and auditable recovery.
alternatives_considered: Direct database-writing autonomous copilot

title: Supplier authority

rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.
alternatives_considered: Duplicated module-local supplier masters

title: Sourcing fairness and evidence
decision: RFQ versions, invitations, bids, evaluations and award decisions preserve confidentiality, immutable evidence and explicit evaluator/approver authority.
rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.
alternatives_considered: Mutable or buyer-only award history

title: Versioned purchasing commitments
decision: Approved/dispatched purchase commitments and contract releases retain immutable versions/snapshots; material changes trigger amendment/reapproval policy.
rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.
alternatives_considered: In-place mutation of committed POs/contracts

title: Stock and Quality ownership
decision: Procurement owns commercial receipt/return context; Stock owns physical inventory movement and Quality owns inspection/hold/disposition authority through public contracts.
rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.
alternatives_considered: Procurement writing Stock/Quality private tables

title: Accounting ownership
decision: Procurement captures supplier invoice/match/landed-cost evidence and requests financial effects; Accounting owns posted AP, tax, payment and ledger truth.
rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.
alternatives_considered: Procurement posting directly to ledger/payable private tables

title: Deterministic procurement math

rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.

title: Demand-driven orchestration
decision: Stock and Manufacturing remain authoritative for replenishment/production demand; Procurement creates one idempotent purchasing effect and stores source lineage/reconciliation.
rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.

title: AI boundary

rationale: Required for enterprise procurement control, auditability, module isolation and safe recovery.

title: Quantity authority

rationale: Derived from Pass 4 repo audit, official benchmark research and enterprise inventory control requirements.
alternatives_considered: Direct balance mutation, UI-only controls and cross-module private table writes rejected.

title: Quality hold interlock

rationale: Derived from Pass 4 repo audit, official benchmark research and enterprise inventory control requirements.
alternatives_considered: Direct balance mutation, UI-only controls and cross-module private table writes rejected.

title: Valuation authority
decision: FIFO, moving-average and standard-cost effects are deterministic Stock subledger rules; Accounting owns GL posting and reconciliation.
rationale: Derived from Pass 4 repo audit, official benchmark research and enterprise inventory control requirements.
alternatives_considered: Direct balance mutation, UI-only controls and cross-module private table writes rejected.

title: AI boundary
decision: AI may explain/recommend/generate work, but cannot authoritatively change physical quantity, reservation, traceability, quality hold or valuation.
rationale: Derived from Pass 4 repo audit, official benchmark research and enterprise inventory control requirements.

title: Module boundary

title: Deterministic manufacturing authority

title: Released-order structure snapshot

title: Stock owns physical inventory
decision: Manufacturing issues/receipts call Stock public commands and retain source movement IDs; Manufacturing does not fork stock balance/valuation logic.

alternatives_considered: Private cross-module mutation; mutable released structures; AI-authoritative calculations; informational-only holds

title: Quality hold is a hard interlock
decision: An applicable production/quality hold blocks material/output release and cannot be bypassed through UI, API, automation, import or scanner channels.
rationale: Makes quality control enforceable rather than informational.
alternatives_considered: Private cross-module mutation; mutable released structures; AI-authoritative calculations; informational-only holds

title: Manufacturing-to-finance reconciliation
decision: Manufacturing cost snapshots and Stock valuation references feed an idempotent Accounting contract with WIP/output/variance reconciliation and reversal lineage.

alternatives_considered: Private cross-module mutation; mutable released structures; AI-authoritative calculations; informational-only holds

title: Project delivery versus financial authority
decision: Projects owns project/WBS/resource/billing eligibility and project analytical state; source transactions remain authoritative in Sales, Procurement, Stock, HR/Payroll and Accounting.

title: Timesheet maker-checker

alternatives_considered: Private cross-module mutation; mutable baselines; self-approved time; direct invoice creation; unreconciled project margin

alternatives_considered: Private cross-module mutation; mutable baselines; self-approved time; direct invoice creation; unreconciled project margin

title: Exactly-once sale identity

rationale: Prevents duplicate customer charge, stock issue and accounting posting during retries/offline sync.

title: External payment truth is stateful
decision: Provider authorization/capture/refund status is never inferred from a timeout; uncertain outcomes remain pending until callback/poll/reconciliation proves state.
rationale: Network ambiguity must not create duplicate charges/refunds.
alternatives_considered: Client-only truth; timeout-as-failure; direct stock/GL writes; mutable closed shifts; raw card-data persistence

title: Offline is a bounded capability mode

rationale: Offline continuity cannot bypass central authorization, stock/accounting truth or create silent divergence.
alternatives_considered: Client-only truth; timeout-as-failure; direct stock/GL writes; mutable closed shifts; raw card-data persistence

title: Deterministic pricing and tax

alternatives_considered: Client-only truth; timeout-as-failure; direct stock/GL writes; mutable closed shifts; raw card-data persistence

title: Accounting owns journals
decision: POS produces idempotent source batches/intents; Accounting owns fiscal period, tax ledger, clearing/cash/variance and GL posting/reversal.
rationale: Preserves modular ownership and period-lock/reconciliation controls.
alternatives_considered: Client-only truth; timeout-as-failure; direct stock/GL writes; mutable closed shifts; raw card-data persistence

decision: POS never mutates inventory balances directly; completed sale/return requests Stock public movements and reconciles source movement IDs.
rationale: Prevents inventory and valuation divergence.
alternatives_considered: Client-only truth; timeout-as-failure; direct stock/GL writes; mutable closed shifts; raw card-data persistence

rationale: Reduces card-data exposure and security scope.
alternatives_considered: Client-only truth; timeout-as-failure; direct stock/GL writes; mutable closed shifts; raw card-data persistence

title: Closed shift/Z facts are immutable
decision: Shift close and Z reports freeze a source fact set; subsequent corrections/refunds/reversals are linked events, not silent historical edits.
rationale: Cash/tender/accounting audit requires reproducible closure.
alternatives_considered: Client-only truth; timeout-as-failure; direct stock/GL writes; mutable closed shifts; raw card-data persistence

title: Quality evidence is versioned and historically stable
decision: Every submitted/approved inspection, NCR, hold, disposition, CAPA, audit and CoA retains the exact governing specification/plan/document/instrument version and is corrected by linked supersession/reopen rather than silent overwrite.
rationale: Quality and audit decisions must remain reproducible.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

title: Active quality hold is a hard movement authorization gate
decision: Every relevant Stock/production movement command checks applicable active holds inside the same authoritative transaction/concurrency boundary; UI warnings alone are insufficient.
rationale: F323 explicitly requires holds to block stock movement, including races.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

title: Hold release is maker-checker and race-safe
decision: Release records approver/reason/evidence, prohibits configured self-release, supports bounded partial scope and cannot race with Stock movement to bypass an active hold.
rationale: Release is a safety-critical transition.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

title: Pass/fail is deterministic
decision: Pass/fail derives from approved specification/tolerance/sample/result/instrument facts and explicit precision rules; AI cannot alter it.
rationale: Quality truth must be reproducible and testable.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

title: Calibration validity gates measurement acceptance
decision: Expired/out-of-tolerance/ineligible measuring equipment blocks or invalidates governed measurement according to policy and triggers impact assessment of affected inspections.
rationale: Measurements without trustworthy instrument state cannot silently become authoritative.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

decision: Quality decides/approves disposition; Stock, Manufacturing, Procurement and Accounting execute their private quantity/work/return/value effects through idempotent public commands.
rationale: Preserves modular ownership and reconciliation.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

title: CAPA closure requires effectiveness evidence
decision: Corrective/preventive actions are not closed merely because tasks are marked done; configured effectiveness verification and evidence are required.
rationale: Prevents checkbox CAPA completion.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

title: Quality cost and KPI formulas are governed
decision: Cost/KPI formulas, populations, cutoffs and dimensions are explicit and reconcile to source facts; AI may explain/analyze but not create authoritative values.
rationale: Management reporting must be reproducible.
alternatives_considered: UI-only hold warning; mutable inspection results; unapproved use-as-is; direct cross-module writes; AI-determined pass/fail; task-only CAPA closure

title: Canonical service identity
decision: Ticket UUID is system identity; human ticket number is stable, unique by tenant policy and never reused.
rationale: Prevents collision and preserves durable references across channels/merges.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: Inbound message idempotency
decision: Email/message ingestion uses normalized message identity, In-Reply-To/References/thread keys and source idempotency so retries cannot create duplicate tickets/comments.
rationale: Required for reliable omni-channel threading.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: Private content boundary
decision: Private notes and their attachments are a separate authorization class and MUST never surface in portal/public notifications/export/search snippets without sensitive permission.
rationale: Prevents severe confidentiality leakage.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: SLA clock truth
decision: SLA timers are deterministic business-calendar clocks with explicit pause/resume/start/stop event history; wall-clock due timestamps alone are insufficient.
rationale: Makes SLA results reproducible and auditable.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: Assignment concurrency
decision: Routing and reassignment use version/lock semantics, eligibility checks and auditable override reason; no silent last-write-wins assignment.
rationale: Prevents routing races and invisible ownership loss.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: Merge preservation
decision: Duplicate merge never deletes source history; canonical target, aliases/redirection and all messages/attachments/audit links remain reconstructable.
rationale: Protects service evidence and customer history.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: Entitlement authority
decision: Support evaluates entitlement from effective-dated public contract evidence; AI or free-text agent judgment cannot become authoritative entitlement truth.
rationale: Preserves contractual consistency.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: Metric anti-gaming
decision: Performance/CSAT/SLA metrics publish formula, exclusions and scope, and must not incentivize unsafe premature closure/reassignment.
rationale: Prevents KPI gaming from degrading customer outcomes.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: AI authority boundary
decision: AI is assistive for triage, summarization, reply drafting, knowledge retrieval, duplicate/risk signals and analytics; deterministic authorization, privacy, SLA, entitlement, merge and state rules remain authoritative.
rationale: Maintains safe AI-native service operations.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; vendor-specific model; AI-as-authority

title: Effective dating
decision: Material employment, organization, compensation, policy and statutory changes are effective-dated; finalized historical payroll retains source snapshot/version.
rationale: Prevents retroactive mutation of paid/audited truth.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Reporting hierarchy
decision: Reporting-manager changes prevent self/direct/indirect cycles and preserve dated history.
rationale: Avoids approval/access recursion.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Attendance event truth
decision: Raw punch/source events are deduplicated and retained; regularization records governed correction instead of deleting evidence.
rationale: Preserves payroll dispute evidence.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Payroll snapshot and maker-checker
decision: Calculation freezes inputs; approval is distinct; approved/finalized payroll cannot be silently recalculated in place.
rationale: Required for deterministic payroll.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Bank file control
decision: Bank files are immutable/versioned outputs of one approved payment set with hash, generator and duplicate controls.
rationale: Prevents accidental double payment/tampering.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Accounting posting/reconciliation
decision: Payroll-to-Accounting uses balanced idempotent posting intents and explicit reversal/reconciliation; Accounting remains ledger authority.
rationale: Prevents duplicate/divergent journals.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Statutory configuration
decision: PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, LWF, gratuity and reports are authoritative-source-backed jurisdiction/tax-year/effective-date configuration; no timeless constants are certified.
rationale: Legal rules change by time/jurisdiction.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Sensitive HR/payroll privacy
decision: Sensitive employee/payroll/document fields use least privilege, masking and channel-safe export/notification rules.
rationale: Payroll/PII has elevated confidentiality risk.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Candidate conversion idempotency
decision: Accepted candidate conversion creates exactly one employee identity and retains application/offer lineage.
rationale: Prevents duplicate employees/history loss.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: AI authority boundary
decision: AI may assist recruiting, drafting, anomaly detection, explanation and recommendations; it never determines payroll/statutory amounts, approvals, employee access, bank/payment/accounting truth or legal state transitions.
rationale: Deterministic authorized systems remain authoritative.
alternatives_considered: UI-only enforcement; timeless hard-coded statutory values; AI-as-authority

title: Immutable posted truth
decision: Posted ledger truth is not edited in place; corrections use linked reversal/adjustment entries with source and approval history.
rationale: Protects auditability and reconciliation.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Double-entry atomicity
decision: Every posting is balanced and atomically commits header, lines, balances/events or commits nothing.
rationale: Prevents partial/unbalanced ledger state.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Period governance
decision: Posting date is validated against fiscal calendar/period status inside the posting transaction; close/reopen is privileged, reasoned and audited.
rationale: Prevents close-vs-post races and backdating.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Money and serialization
decision: Money/rates use explicit decimal precision/rounding and JSON-safe decimal-string contracts; native BigInt must never cross JSON boundaries.
rationale: Addresses deterministic accounting and the repository BigInt/JSON risk.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Financial idempotency
decision: Invoices, receipts, supplier payments, bank imports and callbacks use stable source/external identities so retries cannot duplicate business effects.
rationale: Prevents duplicate receivables/payables/payments/postings.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: India tax configuration
decision: GST/TDS/TCS and tax reporting are authoritative-source-backed jurisdiction/tax-period/effective-date configuration; no timeless rates/thresholds are certified.
rationale: Tax law changes and must be maintainable/auditable.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Currency authority
decision: Exchange-rate source/effective date/precision/override is explicit; realized/unrealized FX entries are linked and reproducible.
rationale: Prevents opaque currency drift.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Consolidation lineage
decision: Consolidation/translation/elimination creates group reporting adjustments without mutating source company ledgers.
rationale: Preserves legal-entity source truth.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Close gate
decision: Financial close requires configured reconciliations or approved exceptions before period lock; reopen forces controlled re-close/reconciliation.
rationale: Prevents false close completeness.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: AI authority boundary
decision: AI may suggest coding, matching, anomalies, forecasts and narrative explanations; it never determines debit/credit balance, ledger/tax/payment truth, period legality, authorization or posting state.
rationale: Deterministic authorized accounting remains authoritative.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Public cross-module posting
decision: Every module posts to Accounting through public balanced/idempotent contracts with source correlation and reversal/reconciliation semantics; no private-table mutation.
rationale: Maintains modular-monolith boundaries and cross-module auditability.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority

title: Report reconciliation
decision: Financial statements/dashboards are defined read models over governed ledger/subledger truth and must drill down/reconcile; spreadsheet-only adjustments cannot be hidden.
rationale: Reports must remain explainable and auditable.
alternatives_considered: UI-only validation; mutable posted records; floating-point money; direct cross-module table writes; AI-as-authority
